# -o replacement is atomic: a failed rebuild leaves the previous
# image byte-identical — whether the fault dies early, at parse
# before the toolchain runs, or late, inside the generated compiler —
# and leaves no temporary litter beside it, while a successful rebuild
# replaces it with an image the CLI itself can read back. The unit
# variants wait outside the solution directory so only the current
# spelling is ever loaded.
[short] skip 'drives the go toolchain'

cd sol
exec go mod edit -replace=github.com/modern-engineering/prototype=$SDLREPO
cp $SDLREPO/go.sum go.sum
sdl build -o out.json
cp out.json prior.json

# Early: the unit no longer parses, so the fault dies before the
# toolchain ever runs.
cp $WORK/variants/broken-parse.sdl sol.sdl
status 1 sdl build -o out.json
cmp out.json prior.json

# Late: the unit parses and the generated compiler rejects it.
cp $WORK/variants/broken-link.sdl sol.sdl
status 1 sdl build -o out.json
cmp out.json prior.json
exec ls
! stdout 'tmp-'

# A successful rebuild replaces the previous image.
cp $WORK/variants/changed.sdl sol.sdl
sdl build -o out.json
! cmp out.json prior.json
sdl image info out.json

-- sol/go.mod --
module example.test/sol

go 1.25.0

require github.com/modern-engineering/prototype v0.0.0
-- sol/sol.sdl --
solution atomic

import ff "github.com/modern-engineering/prototype/examples/ff"

deploy ff.Ping as Ping1 {
	params {
		count: 1
		target: "pong"
	}
}
-- variants/broken-parse.sdl --
solution atomic

deploy 7
-- variants/broken-link.sdl --
solution atomic

import ff "github.com/modern-engineering/prototype/examples/ff"

deploy ff.Gone as G
-- variants/changed.sdl --
solution atomic

import ff "github.com/modern-engineering/prototype/examples/ff"

deploy ff.Ping as Ping1 {
	params {
		count: 2
		target: "pong"
	}
}
